report_policy.core_research_question: Does an activation plateau hold information the model has not used yet? (GPT-2 Large, 'The capital of France is Paris. The capital of' with the country-token embedding interpolated from ' Japan' to ' Germany': does the immediate prediction stay fixed while the delayed, one-token-later prediction ' Tokyo'/' Berlin' changes, and in what shape?)

checklist.request:
For Figure 2, Add the top-token prediction along the interpolation to the plot below. For each interpolation point \(t\), show which token has the highest delayed-logit probability (e.g. Tokyo vs Berlin).
The delayed logits appear to remain Tokyo-like, transition rapidly near the midpoint, and then remain Berlin-like. Visualize the top-token prediction directly so we can see whether the predicted token switches at the same boundary as the delayed-logit transition. Do not assume that they coincide; show the actual switch location from the data.

triage_notes: 'Figure 2' is unambiguous: in both REPORT.md and RESULTS.md it is plots/delayed_distance.png (relative delayed-logit distance d(t) vs interpolation position t). Routing: regenerate that same file via experiments/plot_delayed.py, adding the delayed top-1 token (argmax over the full vocabulary of the stored delayed logits, not restricted to Tokyo/Berlin) at every t, and mark the observed top-1 switch location(s) from data next to the d(t) transition (e.g. t50). Update the Figure 2 caption/prose in REPORT.md and RESULTS.md. No new model run is needed: results/logits_delayed.npy is (101, 50257), full-vocabulary delayed logits at every t.
